title: delivery.fact.attempt_failed v1 payload
description: ADR-0011 D2 — a door visit that ended without a handover. The parcel stays in HUDHUD custody (v6.3 p.28, p.34) and what happens next is decided by operations (OPS-08), so this event carries no disposition of its own.

refusal_reason.description: Optional even when the receiver refused — the Driver App does not require one.

amount_collected_minor_units.description: v6.3 p.34 — nothing is collected on a refusal or a failed attempt.

parcel_remains_in_hudhud_custody.description: Stated rather than implied: a failed attempt never transfers custody.
